title: Prospective Transport-Failure Localization, Pre-Intervention Search-State Quotienting, Outcome-Blind Regime Stratification, Relation-Law Conditionalization & Minimal Architecture-Invariant Causal Object Reconstitution

holdout_design.eligible_pool: P22 SHAM-censused cells excluding every P22 selected cell
holdout_design.selector: unchanged P22 Rust 64-start quota best-improvement matcher
holdout_design.quota: 6 cells per material family x side-to-move = 96 total
holdout_design.balance_gate: max absolute SMD <= 0.50 on the nine frozen P20/P22 cross-engine exposure coordinates
holdout_design.runtime: Threads=1; Hash=64 MiB if exposed; Clear Hash/cold process; 300000 nodes per selective arm

search_state_quotient.coordinate: median(SF19 Q_SHARE, Berserk Q_SHARE, Ethereal Q_SHARE) measured in the already outcome-blind 80k SHAM census
search_state_quotient.symmetry: engine labels enter only through a symmetric median
search_state_quotient.stratification: within each material-family x side-to-move quota, rank the six selected cells by the coordinate then candidate SHA; lowest three = Q_LOW, highest three = Q_HIGH
search_state_quotient.support: exactly 3 cells per family x side x regime; therefore 6 cells per material vertex x regime

adjudication.primary_outcome: fine exact-world value change, inherited from P20-P22
adjudication.p20_conditional_recovery: Within a frozen regime, all three admitted engines must be CURVED/QSEARCH/-1 on HEAVY_HEAVY and MINOR_MINOR must not share one common CURVED fingerprint.
adjudication.strict_conditional_naturality: Within a frozen regime, all three engine pairs must satisfy inherited P20 compatible() on both HEAVY_HEAVY and MINOR_MINOR.
adjudication.minimal_object_rule: Choose the coarsest nontrivial level whose value is identical across all three engines for every regime x square cell and takes at least two distinct values across those cells. If none exists, no architecture-invariant causal object is reconstituted.
adjudication.failure_localization: Distinguish architecture-dominant persistence from search-state-modulated disagreement and conditional convergence without changing the quotient after outcomes are opened.
adjudication.robust_wdl: reported only; never substituted for the frozen fine-value outcome

fail_closed: Any P22-selected SHA in P23 selection aborts.
Any balance/certificate failure aborts before selective intervention.
No result-driven threshold, quotient, arm, node-budget, or engine-set change is permitted.
